text: Whimsical means playful and a little silly, in a charming way. Here, building tiny houses is called a whimsical hobby because it is fun and unusual rather than practical.
Escapism means losing yourself in something fun to take a break from real life and its worries. Here, building a tiny world gives people a calm place to go.
To bemoan something is to complain about it sadly because you wish it were different. Here, traditional makers bemoan new machines because they feel the machines make the craft too easy.
Miniatures are very small copies of real things, like tiny houses, furniture or whole cities. People collect them or build them as a hobby.
A Victorian house is built in the style popular in Britain and America in the 1800s, when Queen Victoria ruled. These houses often have tall roofs and fancy decoration.
When a house hits the market, it has just been put up for sale for the first time.
Renovated means fixed up and made new again, like repainting and replacing old floors in a house.
A wraparound porch curves around the corner of a house so it covers more than one side.
Here, the catch is the hidden problem that makes a good deal less good. The house sounds great, but it is tiny. Catch can also mean to grab a ball.
To jump on the bandwagon means to join something because it has become popular. Here, lots of new people are joining the miniatures craze.
Hobbyists are people who do an activity for fun in their free time, not as a job.
Collectors gather and keep a certain kind of item, like stamps, cards or tiny furniture.
Tripling means becoming three times as big. If a store sold 100 things and now sells 300, its sales have tripled.
Net sales are the money a store really keeps from selling, after refunds for returned items are taken out.
Retailers are businesses that sell things directly to customers, like stores and websites.
A guild is a group of people who do the same craft and join together to help each other and share skills.
Artisans are skilled people who make things by hand, like woodworkers or potters.
A resurgence is a comeback, when something rises in popularity again after a quieter time.
A pastime is something you do for fun to pass the time, like a hobby.
Analogue here means old-fashioned and hands-on, not done on a screen or computer. Making a model with glue and wood is analogue.
Grandma hobbies are old-fashioned crafts like knitting, baking and puzzles. They are called this as a joke, because they are now popular with young people too.
Covid is the illness that spread around the world starting in 2020. Many people stayed home for a long time and tried new hobbies.
Instability means a time when things are shaky and uncertain, so people do not feel sure about what will happen next.
Here, appeals means is attractive or interesting to people. It can also mean to ask for something, or to ask a judge to change a decision.
Making something from scratch means making it from basic materials instead of buying it ready-made, like baking a cake without a mix.
Reality TV shows follow real people in contests or daily life instead of actors reading a script.
A feat is an impressive achievement. No small feat means something is very hard to do.
A curator is the person who picks and takes care of the items shown in a museum or exhibition.
A replica is an exact copy of something, often smaller. Here it is a model of the whole city of New York.
Balsa is a very light, soft wood that is easy to cut, so it is popular for model planes and miniatures.
Here, craft means making things skillfully by hand. As a verb, to craft something is to make it carefully.
Intricate means full of tiny, detailed parts that took great care to make.
An uptick is a small rise or increase in something, like more people joining a hobby.
3D printing is a way to make real objects by having a machine build them up layer by layer from a computer design.
Laser-cutting uses a strong beam of light to cut shapes very precisely out of wood, paper or plastic.
Enticed means attracted by something that sounds tempting. New tools drew new makers to the hobby.
Traditionalists are people who prefer to keep doing things the old way.
To cut corners means to take shortcuts and skip steps, often making the work worse. Here it is a joke, since laser cutters really do cut corners of wood.
To be in the thrall of something means to be so charmed by it that you cannot stop thinking about it.

forms: It’s a small world, after all
text: This is a line from a famous Disney song about the world. The writer uses it as a joke about tiny things.
